narratives.body: AllNigeriaSoccer confirms a French-born Super Falcons-eligible forward has joined Chelsea on a professional deal, while Soccer News reports plans for a future move for Strasbourg winger Gessime Yassine. Football London notes that Estevao received brutally honest transfer advice despite Xabi Alonso's promise, and 3News reports that former Berekum midfielder Bediako has moved to Atletico. BeSoccer Livescore indicates Penders was handed an opportunity following Emi Martinez's injury, and CaughtOffside reports that a Chelsea player with 23 minutes of playing time this season is urged to leave the club.
narratives.headline: Chelsea transfer and squad news reports

narratives.body: Chelsea Football Club's official site features Danny Welbeck discussing leadership, family, and community honouring; Rachael Adedini's profile is highlighted; and George Weah recalls his historic debut derby winner against Tottenham.
narratives.headline: Chelsea FC official profiles and interviews

narratives.body: London Evening Standard reveals the timeline of games Emi Martinez will miss after her surgery and confirms her new Chelsea aim post-op. Daily Mirror claims Chelsea are 'bigger and worse offenders' than Man City, a sentiment echoed by Football London despite an 114 charges guilty verdict.
narratives.headline: Chelsea injury updates and conduct reports
